label: Numerical grounding and choice-partition controls for the invariant source
description: Quantitative completion of the chance rival at the invariant source. The qualitative description (histories, support, strict ranking, tied optimality) leaves the binary law open; one calibrated mass or full exchange symmetry fixes it, a two-element orbit with a singleton does not. Identical histories admit STIT cells with or without the giver's seeing to the giving. Diagnostic controls, not a proof that a fixed complete essence permits variable intrinsic propensities, that a necessary nature grounds or cannot ground a particular law, or that intention guarantees sufficient reason. Not a transcription; establishes no premise.
